**`ai/index.ts`**: `process.exit(1)` inside a library function is a code defect — it kills the process before `withTelemetry`'s catch can do anything. The `if (projectInfo.framework !== '@storybook/react-vite') { return; }` guard is a silent no-op with no user feedback. Also `console.log` vs `logger` inconsistency.

**`ai/prompt.ts`**: The `renderer` variable is passed directly into `` `@storybook/${renderer}` `` in `getCsfExample`. The explorer confirmed `rendererPackage` from `getStorybookInfo` returns the full scoped package name (e.g. `@storybook/react`), not just `react`. So the generated example import becomes `@storybook/@storybook/react` — a real bug in the generated prompt text.

**`ai/types.ts`**: Stale JSDoc ("skill category") and type mismatch (`string | null` declared but `?? 'unknown'` means never null in practice).

**`create-storybook/src/bin/run.ts`**: `logger.log('Detecting agent presence: ...')` runs unconditionally, so every user sees "Detecting agent presence: undefined". `detectAgent()` is also called twice redundantly.

**`create-storybook/src/initiate.ts`**: The `import('../../cli-storybook/src/ai')` is a source-level cross-package import, bypassing `cli-storybook`'s entry point entirely. Fragile against any internal reorganization.

**`detect-agent.ts`**: Several env vars (CLINE, WINDSURF, BOLT, LOVABLE, etc.) aren't established conventions — false positives would silently enable `options.yes = true`.

No tests for any of the new modules.
